resolved.title: 数据类型
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Data Types[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The operating system allocates memory and selects what will be stored in the reserved memory based on the variable's [b]data type[/b].
The data type defines the proper use of an identifier, what kind of data can be stored, and which types of operations can be performed.
[note]There are a number of built-in types in C++.
Tap [b]Continue [/b]to learn more![/note]

content.text:
在编程时，你可能需要存储各种数据类型的信息，操作系统会根据变量的数据类型，来分配内存和决定在保留内存中存储什么。

数据类型定义了标识符的正确使用，可以存储什么类型的数据，以及可以执行哪些类型的操作。
content.text_html:
The operating system allocates memory and selects what will be stored in the reserved memory based on the variable's data type. The data type defines the proper use of an identifier, what kind of data can be stored, and which types of operations can be performed.

操作系统分配内存，并根据变量的**数据类型来选择保留的内存中要存储的内容。 数据类型定义了一个标识符的正确使用，可以存储什么样的数据，以及可以进行哪些类型的操作。

content.text: 在C++中，提供了丰富的内置数据类型。点击**继续**了解更多!
content.text_html:
There are a number of built-in types in C++. Tap **Continue **to learn more!

在C++中，有许多内置类型。 点击继续可以了解更多!

resolved.title: 字符串及字符
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Strings & Characters[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

A [b]string [/b]is composed of numbers, characters, or symbols. String literals are placed in [b]double quotation[/b] marks; some examples are "Hello", "My name is David", and similar.

[b]Characters [/b]are single letters or symbols, and must be enclosed between [b]single quotes[/b], like 'a', 'b', etc.
[note]In C++, single quotation marks indicate a [b]character[/b]; double quotes create a [b]string [/b]literal. While 'a' is a single a character literal, "a" is a string literal.[/note]
[s0l0!-coach id="429" name="Once Upon A Time In America" xp="10" description="Write a program to output the name and the release year of a famous movie." imageUrl="/content/assets/3e0a49356e2493f44931.png" button="Start" color="5e98cf"]Practice what you've learned.[/s0l0!-coach]
resolved.description_en:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Strings & Characters[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

A [b]string [/b]is composed of numbers, characters, or symbols. String literals are placed in [b]double quotation[/b] marks; some examples are "Hello", "My name is David", and similar.

[b]Characters [/b]are single letters or symbols, and must be enclosed between [b]single quotes[/b], like 'a', 'b', etc.
[note]In C++, single quotation marks indicate a [b]character[/b]; double quotes create a [b]string [/b]literal. While 'a' is a single a character literal, "a" is a string literal.[/note]

content.text:
一个**字符串**是由数字，字符或符号组成，字符串文本放在**双引号**(`"`)中，如 "Hi:，"My name is Pythontip" 等。

**字符**是单个字母或符号，必须包含在**单引号**(`'`)之间，如 'a'，'b'等。
content.text_html:
A **string **is composed of numbers, characters, or symbols. String literals are placed in double quotation marks; some examples are "Hello", "My name is David", and similar.

**Characters **are single letters or symbols, and must be enclosed between single quotes, like 'a', 'b', etc.

一个字符串是由数字、字符或符号组成的。字符串的字面意义放在**双引号中；一些例子是 "你好"、"我的名字是大卫"，以及类似的。

字符是单个字母或符号，必须放在**单引号之间，如 "a"、"b "等。

content.text: 在C++ 中，单引号表示一个**字符**，双引号创建一个**字符串**文本。因此，'a' 是单个字符，"a" 是字符串。
content.text_html:
In C++, single quotation marks indicate a character; double quotes create a **string **literal. While 'a' is a single a character literal, "a" is a string literal.

在C++中，单引号表示一个字符；双引号创建一个字符串字头。虽然'a'是一个单一的a字符字面，但 "a "是一个字符串字面。
